title: 5 Best Retro Handhelds for Killer PS2 Emulation - All Tested
summary: RetroResolve compares five very different handheld routes to PS2 play in 2023—Logitech G Cloud, Pimax Portal, Steam Deck, AYANEO Pocket Air and ROG Ally—while disclosing which manufacturers supplied samples.
searchKeywords: G Cloud vs Steam Deck PS2

blocks.text: The fourteen-minute buyer’s guide gives each device a chapter and spans Android streaming-oriented hardware, compact Android performance, a Linux handheld and Windows PCs. That variety makes the central comparison larger than one benchmark: controls, screen, operating system, portability, price and emulator maturity all influence whether a device is a good PS2 machine. A linked written version supports scanning, and the creator explicitly lists Pimax, AYANEO and Logitech review samples with pages explaining the publication’s review policy.

The ranking is anchored to October 2023 prices and software, before later handhelds and emulator changes. Not every unit shares an operating system or uses the same PS2 emulator, so raw performance cannot be isolated from platform differences. Sample disclosure improves transparency but does not eliminate subjective selection. Verify current prices, battery condition, display and warranty, then compare a matched demanding game under documented power limits. Preserve the video as a period market map, not a current “best five” list or universal compatibility table.
